clue.text: Husband's a very versatile fellow

parts.note: H is the standard abbreviation for husband, as in family records

indicators.note: something versatile can turn into many forms, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A man praised for being able to turn his hand to anything around the home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'versatile' rearranges A VERY into ARVEY, which follows H.
explanation.definitionFit: Harvey is a man's first name, so it can stand for an individual chap or bloke.

clue.text: Female's dietary disorder passed from a generation to generation

definitions.text: passed from a generation to generation

parts.note: her is the possessive pronoun for a woman

indicators.note: a disorder is a jumbled state, so the letters of the next word are scrambled

explanation.surface: A woman's eating disorder that runs in families.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disorder' looks like part of the medical phrase 'dietary disorder', but it is the anagram signal for the word before it.
explanation.definitionFit: Traits that are inherited are transmitted from parents to their offspring down the generations.

clue.text: Polish male joins in a dance

indicators.note: the male letter joins in, entering the polishing word

parts.note: to polish something is to rub it

explanation.surface: A man from Poland takes part in a dance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Polish' looks like a nationality, but it is the verb meaning to shine.
explanation.definitionFit: The rumba is a Latin ballroom dance of Cuban origin.

clue.text: In the event, is absorbed by lyric poem

indicators.note: the word is gets absorbed, taken inside the poem word

parts.note: an epode is a kind of lyric poem, as written by Horace

explanation.surface: Something happening, taken in through the medium of a lyric poem.
explanation.definitionFit: An episode is an incident or happening, one occurrence in a series.

clue.text: Family reaching South Africa has entered capital

parts.note: kin are one's family or relations

indicators.note: the word has has gone into the abbreviation for South Africa

explanation.surface: A family reaches South Africa and makes its way into a capital city.
explanation.definitionFit: Kinshasa is the capital city of the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

clue.text: One fails to start fire

indicators.note: the word for one loses its opening letter

parts.note: single means one

explanation.surface: A person who cannot get a fire going.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fire' looks like the object of 'fails to start', but it is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: An ingle is a fireside or the fire burning in a hearth, an old Scots word.

clue.text: One giving orders upset acting school coach

indicators.note: in a down clue, upset means the run of letters is turned upside down, read bottom to top

parts.note: RADA is the Royal Academy of Dramatic Art, a London drama school
a bus is a coach

explanation.surface: A commander knocks over a bus taking drama students.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' turns RADA + BUS into SUBADAR. RADA, the Royal Academy of Dramatic Art, is a London drama school.
explanation.definitionFit: A subadar was an Indian army officer or provincial governor, a person in command who issued instructions.

clue.text: A spot where sailors and soldiers U ID received decoration

indicators.note: the spot word has received the sailors and soldiers inside it

parts.note: a dot is a spot
RN, the Royal Navy, stands for sailors
men are soldiers, as in officers and men

explanation.surface: A place where servicemen are welcomed and given a medal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'received' is the container signal. The printed 'U ID' looks like an OCR scrap and plays no part in the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: An adornment is an ornament or embellishment, something that decorates.

clue.text: Female fashion (no frills)

indicators.note: frills are edges, so the word for fashion loses its first and last letters

parts.note: fashion means manner, as in 'in this fashion'

explanation.surface: A woman's style of dress, plain and unadorned.
explanation.walkthrough: 'no frills' strips the first and last letters from MANNER.
explanation.definitionFit: Anne is a woman's first name, so it can stand for a female.

clue.text: Relax, finding opportunity to entertain daughter at noon

indicators.note: the opportunity word entertains, holds inside it, the daughter letter

parts.note: a window is an opportunity, as in a window for talks

explanation.surface: Taking it easy, having found the chance to host a daughter at midday.
explanation.definitionFit: To wind down is to unwind or relax after effort.

clue.text: Staying over

definitions.meaning: left over, as in what is over after a meal

explanation.definitionFit: Remaining means both staying behind and being left over as surplus.

clue.text: After half portion of bran, have toast

indicators.note: after places the second piece behind the first
half of the word bran is its first half

parts.note: to own is to have

explanation.surface: Breakfast advice: after some bran, have toast.
explanation.definitionFit: To toast bread is to brown it under heat.

clue.text: One card? We would love to receive any number for this occasion

parts.note: a diamond is one card of a suit in a pack
we'd is the contraction of we would

indicators.note: the love word receives the number letter inside it

parts.note: to dig something is slang for loving it
N stands for any number in mathematics

explanation.surface: A greetings card message saying the senders would be delighted to welcome everyone to the celebration.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to receive' puts N inside DIG to make DING.
explanation.definitionFit: A diamond wedding is the sixtieth wedding anniversary, an occasion for celebration.

clue.text: Newspaper taking liberal line

parts.note: broad means liberal, tolerant, as in broad-minded
a sheet is a rope or line controlling a sail

explanation.surface: A newspaper with a liberal editorial stance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'line' looks like an editorial line; on a boat a sheet is a rope.
explanation.definitionFit: A broadsheet is a newspaper printed on large pages, traditionally a serious paper.

clue.text: At first, teenager has to suffer facial hair

indicators.note: at first takes only the opening letter of the next word

parts.note: to ache is to suffer pain

explanation.surface: A teenage boy's first moustache is something he has to put up with.
explanation.definitionFit: Tache is informal British slang for a moustache, the hair on the upper lip.

clue.text: Dispatched army scout as usual

indicators.note: dispatched means sent off or dealt with, so the letters are broken up and rearranged

explanation.surface: An army scout sent out, as is the routine.
explanation.definitionFit: Something customary is habitual or usual, done by custom.

clue.text: Shivering, we rate our winter clothes

indicators.note: shivering means shaking, so the letters are shaken into a new order

explanation.surface: Cold people judging the coats they wear in winter.
explanation.definitionFit: Outerwear means coats and jackets worn over other clothes, especially in cold weather.

clue.text: After short time, one wears thin coat, being more fashion-conscious?

indicators.note: after places the rest behind the time letter

parts.note: T is the abbreviation for time

indicators.note: the coat word is worn around the numeral, which sits inside it

parts.note: render is a thin coat of plaster on a wall
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Someone who quickly dons a flimsy coat to look more stylish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'thin coat' looks like clothing; it is the plasterer's render.
explanation.definitionFit: Trendier means more in line with current fashion, a comparative adjective.

clue.text: Home brewed cider seen on display

indicators.note: brewed means cooked up, so these letters are concocted into a new order

explanation.surface: Home-made cider is shown off to visitors.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brewed' rearranges CIDER SEEN; 'Home brewed' reads as one phrase, but 'Home' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A residence is a dwelling or house where someone lives.

clue.text: Stalemate, getting recital for Leicester by Dickens

indicators.note: a recital is a spoken performance, so the word is heard, not read

parts.note: deadlock is a stalemate, where neither side can win

explanation.surface: A stalemate in a reading of Dickens.
explanation.walkthrough: Sir Leicester Dedlock is a character in Dickens's Bleak House; his surname is said like the word for stalemate. 'Leicester' looks like the English city.
explanation.definitionFit: Sir Leicester Dedlock is the baronet in Charles Dickens's novel Bleak House.

clue.text: Old city in grip of dope trade

indicators.note: the answer sits held in the grip of the following words

explanation.surface: An ancient city controlled by the drugs trade.
explanation.definitionFit: Petra is the ancient rock-cut city in Jordan, capital of the Nabataeans.

clue.text: Plain look adopted by priest? No way

indicators.note: the look word is adopted, taken in, by the shortened priest
no means the way letters are removed from the word priest

parts.note: taken as written
ST is the abbreviation for street, a way
an air is a look or appearance

explanation.surface: A clergyman takes on a plain appearance, with no way out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'No way' is a deletion, with 'way' as the street abbreviation; 'adopted by' then puts the look inside what is left, PRIE.
explanation.definitionFit: A prairie is a large open grassy plain, especially in North America.

clue.text: Bloomer in Burke's Peerage?

parts.note: a bloomer is a flower; Burke's Peerage lists titled men and women, whose plant name this would be

explanation.walkthrough: 'Bloomer' looks like a blunder; it is a flowering plant. Burke's Peerage is the reference book of the British aristocracy.
explanation.definitionFit: Lords and ladies is a common name for the wild arum, a woodland plant, and also describes peers.

clue.text: You'll need a place to lie down after second course

indicators.note: after puts the bed word behind the second letter

parts.note: a cot is a small bed

explanation.surface: You will want a bed after the second course of a meal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'course' looks like part of a meal; Ascot is an English racecourse.
explanation.definitionFit: Ascot is a famous racecourse in Berkshire, England, home of Royal Ascot.

clue.text: Drive one mile, parking on raised track

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
P is the symbol for parking
an el is an elevated railway in the US

explanation.surface: Driving a mile and parking beside an overhead railway.
explanation.definitionFit: To impel is to drive or push forward.

clue.text: Second judge meets suspect briefly

indicators.note: briefly means the word is cut short, losing its last letter

parts.note: iffy means suspect or dubious

explanation.surface: A judge quickly meets a suspect.
explanation.walkthrough: 'suspect' looks like a noun; it is the adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: A jiff, short for jiffy, is a moment or a second.

clue.text: US state initially lacking opera house

indicators.note: the opera name lacks its first letter

parts.note: Aida is the opera by Verdi

explanation.surface: An American state that has no opera house to start with.
explanation.definitionFit: Idaho is a state in the north-western United States.

clue.text: Sweet, fragrant flower

definitions.meaning: a sweet is a dessert, such as a fruit pie
a garden heliotrope is popularly named after a pie, from its scent

explanation.definitionFit: Cherry pie is a dessert, and also a popular name for the heliotrope, with its fruity scent.

clue.text: Test public opinion? Not with 9, presumably

definitions.meaning: to float an idea to see how people react
with the wind dropping, the entry at 9-down, a toy on a string would not stay up

explanation.definitionFit: To fly a kite is an idiom for floating an idea to test reactions; literally it needs a breeze.

clue.text: Wine lake finally cleared by region of France

indicators.note: the lake word has its final letter cleared away

parts.note: a mere is a lake
the Lot is a department in south-west France

explanation.surface: A French lake region drained to make way for vines.
explanation.definitionFit: Merlot is a red wine grape variety and the wine made from it.
